text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's like... something hot is coursing 
straight through my body...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's strange. I feel like I could 
keep charging straight to the top just 
like this...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Goddesses... Please watch over me. I'll 
show you what I can do!
